fact: MCC states that at a rural health centre in Lesotho an HIV-positive pregnant woman's care is recorded in an electronic medical record linked to the national health information system, pharmacy and laboratory systems, while a woman negative for HIV and TB has her care recorded on paper, in a health booklet she carries, and manually tabulated and entered into the national health information system; MCC plans digital health investment across all disease areas from early 2024.
title: MCC Set to Invest in Stronger Digital Health Systems in Lesotho
